assumptions: Conditional approval; zero fee; every shifted payment remains in original month; opening proxy uses up to six completed pre-July months
methodology: July–December 2025 complete-history cohort. Start with the mean daily balance from up to six completed pre-July account months, scale all observed inflows to 55%, and increase identified household bills by 15%. Measure end-of-day cash, then replay a conditional seven-day move of one recurring bill identified from pre-July history. Every shifted payment stays in its original month.
